chrome-vp9-streaming.webm is a synthetic red/blue canvas recorded with local Chrome MediaRecorder (VP9 WebM, 1.8 seconds). No webcam or personal media was used. It lacks seekable duration/frame-count metadata and reproduces OpenCV placeholder FPS and post-seek decode failures. Retained for decoder regression tests; no browser or model download is needed.

ordinary.mp4 is a synthetic 32x24, 30 FPS, one-second gray-ramp video encoded with OpenCV mp4v for ordinary-upload regression coverage.
